RequiredFindings.Defect: A-1 marks M-04 NO and classifies the amendment as Coordinator-only even though it changes how the required protocol control is satisfied by substituting a mechanical bridge for the controller-executed nc2. M-04 is defined by the change to what fails or how it fails, not only by product behavior.
RequiredFindings.Authority: INITIATIVE_LIFECYCLE Sec.3 M-04 and Sec.6: a material M requires Architect and Coordinator authority.
RequiredFindings.Correction: Mark M-04 YES and obtain Architect and Coordinator review before activation, or revise the amendment so it does not change the frozen control or its satisfaction conditions.

RequiredFindings.Defect: A-1 permits the bridge to satisfy nc2 instead of the model-executed control. This substitutes the actor and execution method required by I-61 README Sec.10 for I-64, despite the claim that A-1 only adds an I-64 evidence requirement.
RequiredFindings.Authority: docs/automation/agent-execution/README.md Sec.10 requires the real Controller to execute negative controls with the same prompt. The historical I-64 Coordinator decision prohibits changing I-61 from I-64 and identifies a protocol-owner decision or integrated protocol evolution as the route to a conforming replacement.
RequiredFindings.Correction: Obtain and version the protocol-owner authority for this I-64 replacement control before activation, or revise A-1 so the bridge is additional evidence and does not substitute for an I-61 requirement.

Limitations: The verifier and self-test were not executed, as instructed. The committed self-test result was inspected, but this review does not independently reproduce it.
No claim is made about GATE PASS, candidacy, closure, integration, or Owner approval.
